title: ShareRecord
description: One share row as surfaced by the API. grant_option is not exposed in v1 (always false, so it is omitted). `active` is derived from `revoked_at` (empty string == active). `grantee_id` is the resolved subject (user) or group id ('public' for the built-in group).

grantee_id.description: Resolved subject ('issuer:sub') for a user, or the group id ('public') for a group.

permission.description: 'read' in v1 (the API rejects the rest); 'owner' may appear on the owner row surfaced in a listing.

granted_by.description: Subject of the grantor (the caller's tenant), or 'system:backfill' for a startup-seeded row.

revoked_by.description: Subject that revoked the row; empty string while active.

revoked_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of revocation; empty string while active.

active.description: True when the row has not been revoked (`revoked_at` is empty).
